newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T says judge rejects W.Virginia lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T says judge rejects W.Virginia lawsuit.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc said on Monday that a West Virginia judge had formally rejected efforts by that U.S. state to recover Medicaid expenditures from the tobacco industry on behalf of individuals allegedly harmed by smoking-related diseases.
The British tobacco and insurance conglomerate said in a statement that the judge ruled the state could not bring the claims without bringing forward those people who were allegedly injured.

"We are delighted with today's decision, which represents a significant victory for the tobacco industry and cripples the ability of the state to continue its lawsuit," said David Bernick, attorney for Brown & Williamson, a B.A.T unit.
